Implemented the repair in src/dotenv/parser.py only.

Change: line 30, `_rest_of_line` alternation reordered from `(?:\r|\n|\r\n)?` to `(?:\r\n|\n|\r)?`, so a CRLF is matched as one complete newline (consistent with `_newline` and `_end_of_line`).

Effect: In `parse_binding`'s error path, `reader.read_regex(_rest_of_line)` now consumes the entire `\r\n`. The invalid binding's `original.string` includes the whole CRLF, and the following valid binding starts at line 2 with `original.string == "GOOD=ok\n"`. LF and lone-CR behavior are unchanged (those alternatives still match), and repeated invalid lines each consume exactly one terminator.

No tests, docs, other modules, or dependencies were modified. Ready for host test run.
